Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the Wikipedia page and conflated the paternal grandmother (Concepción Sáenz de Tejada y Fernández de Bobadilla, mother of Jaime de Marichalar) with the maternal grandmother, despite the page explicitly stating he is the maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofía (i.e., Queen Sofía is the correct maternal grandmother).
